hooks.command: sh -c 'payload=$(cat); case "$payload" in *commit*|*g*i*t*c*o*m*m*i*t*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; repo_root=; case "${MUSE_SESSION_ID:-}" in ""|*[!A-Za-z0-9-]*) ;; *) repo_root=$(cat "$HOME/.cache/dart-muse-hooks/$MUSE_SESSION_ID.root" 2>/dev/null) ;; esac; if [ -z "$repo_root" ]; then repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; fi; [ -n "$repo_root" ] && printf "%s" "$payload" | CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$repo_root" CODEX_PROJECT_DIR="$repo_root" "$repo_root/.claude/hooks/pre-commit-guard.sh" || { echo "DART guard: hook failed; blocking" >&2; exit 2; }'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$payload = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($payload -notmatch '(?s)commit|g.*i.*t.*c.*o.*m.*m.*i.*t') { exit 0 }; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; try { $repoRoot = $null; $cacheHome = $env:HOME; if (-not $cacheHome) { $cacheHome = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('UserProfile') }; if ($env:MUSE_SESSION_ID -match '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$') { $cache = Join-Path $cacheHome ('.cache/dart-muse-hooks/' + $env:MUSE_SESSION_ID + '.root'); if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cache) { $repoRoot = Get-Content -LiteralPath $cache -Raw } }; if (-not $repoRoot) { $repoRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel }; if (-not $repoRoot) { throw 'git did not return a repository root' }; $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR = $repoRoot.Trim(); $env:CODEX_PROJECT_DIR = $repoRoot.Trim(); $payload | & (Join-Path $repoRoot.Trim() '.claude/hooks/pre-commit-guard.ps1'); if (-not $? -or $LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'guard failed' }; exit 0 } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('DART guard: hook failed; blocking'); exit 2 }"

onFailure.command: sh -c 'cat >/dev/null; echo "DART guard: hook failed or timed out; blocking" >&2; exit 2'
onFailure.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$null = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); [Console]::Error.WriteLine('DART guard: hook failed or timed out; blocking'); exit 2"

hooks.command: sh -c 'cat >/dev/null; umask 077; case "${MUSE_SESSION_ID:-}" in ""|*[!A-Za-z0-9-]*) exit 2 ;; esac; repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && [ -x "$repo_root/.claude/hooks/pre-commit-guard.sh" ] && mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/dart-muse-hooks" && printf "%s" "$repo_root" >"$HOME/.cache/dart-muse-hooks/$MUSE_SESSION_ID.root"'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$null = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; try { $cacheHome = $env:HOME; if (-not $cacheHome) { $cacheHome = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('UserProfile') }; if ($env:MUSE_SESSION_ID -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$') { throw 'missing session ID' }; $repoRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if (-not $repoRoot -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $repoRoot '.claude/hooks/pre-commit-guard.ps1'))) { throw 'missing guard' }; $cacheDir = Join-Path $cacheHome '.cache/dart-muse-hooks'; $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $cacheDir; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $cacheDir ($env:MUSE_SESSION_ID + '.root')), $repoRoot); exit 0 } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('DART guard: session setup failed'); exit 2 }"

onFailure.command: sh -c 'cat >/dev/null; echo "DART guard: hook failed or timed out; blocking" >&2; exit 2'
onFailure.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$null = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); [Console]::Error.WriteLine('DART guard: hook failed or timed out; blocking'); exit 2"

hooks.command: sh -c 'cat >/dev/null; case "${MUSE_SESSION_ID:-}" in ""|*[!A-Za-z0-9-]*) exit 0 ;; esac; rm -f "$HOME/.cache/dart-muse-hooks/$MUSE_SESSION_ID.root"'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$null = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $cacheHome = $env:HOME; if (-not $cacheHome) { $cacheHome = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('UserProfile') }; if ($env:MUSE_SESSION_ID -match '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$') { $cache = Join-Path $cacheHome ('.cache/dart-muse-hooks/' + $env:MUSE_SESSION_ID + '.root'); Remove-Item -LiteralPath $cache -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0"
